theater: 巴克特里亞與興都庫什山麓

battle.name: 塞琉古入侵巴克特里亞
battle.theater: 巴克特里亞與興都庫什山麓
battle.brief: 公元前二一〇年，安條克三世趁巴克特里亞總督狄奧多圖斯被薩迦人逐出、歐提德莫斯一世根基未穩之際發兵東進，越興都庫什山，於阿里烏斯河畔以騎兵迂迴擊潰巴克特里亞與薩迦聯軍，再圍巴克特拉堡壘約兩年，迫其納貢交子。卡面的埃及長矛早於本役約三千年，不會上戰場，長杆刺擊形制由方陣薩里沙承接。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是塞琉古王國對希臘巴克特里亞王國的一次征服性遠征，屬於安條克三世在位期間的東方戰役。塞琉古一方以安條克三世親率的王軍為主體，骨架是馬其頓—阿開亞樣式的方陣步兵，持薩里沙長矛結陣，輔以輕裝步兵與標槍手、波斯式複合弓的弓手、投石索手、馬其頓式胸甲騎兵與護衛騎兵，並有象隊與隨軍工匠組成的攻城大隊；後方還有以安息控制的花剌子模、粟特一線商路輸送的糧秣與攻城器械。與塞琉古同盟的托勒密王朝治下的埃及，雖然本役未派兵到巴克特里亞，卻是這一體系中提供非洲象與方陣步兵經驗的另一個成員。希臘巴克特里亞一方則是多民族國家：首都巴克特拉是希臘移民後裔的聚居地，國王歐提德莫斯一世以馬其頓式方陣與騎兵為骨幹，同時還要對付尚未完全臣服的薩迦（塞種）游牧部族。薩迦人是最終與巴克特里亞結成一條戰線的武力，以複合反曲弓與大量輕騎兵見長，機動性遠高於希臘步軍。此外，東方的孔雀王朝、西方的安息（帕提亞）、阿開亞同盟與羅馬，都以各自的方式牽動這場戰爭的走向：安條克三世正在西線與安息交戰，這直接決定了他能給東征留出多少時間。
countriesEn: This war was a conquest expedition by the Seleucid kingdom against the Greco-Bactrian kingdom, and it formed part of the eastern campaigns of Antiochus III. On the Seleucid side the field army was led by Antiochus III in person, its backbone formed of phalanx infantry in the Macedonian-Achaean manner standing behind sarissas, supported by light infantry and javelin-men, archers using Persian-style composite bows, slingers, Macedonian cuirassed cavalry and companion cavalry, together with a column of elephants and a siege corps of craftsmen attached to the army; behind them the grain and the siege equipment came in along the caravan routes of Khwarezm and Sogdia, which lay in the hands of the Parthians. The Ptolemaic kingdom of Egypt, although it sent no troops to Bactria, was another member of the same coalition, and it was the member that supplied African elephants and the phalanx experience. The Greco-Bactrian side was a multi-ethnic state: the capital Bactra was a settlement of the descendants of Greek colonists, and King Euthydemus I built his army on a Macedonian-style phalanx and cavalry while still having to hold in check the Saka (Scythian) nomads, who were not yet fully subdued. The Saka were the force that finally joined the Bactrians on the same front line, and they were at their best on the short composite recurved bow and on light cavalry far more mobile than any Greek infantry could manage. Beyond the two sides, the Mauryan Empire in the east, the Arsacid Parthia in the west, the Achaean League and Rome all pulled on the course of the war in their different ways: Antiochus III was already fighting the Parthians on his western front, and that single fact determined how much time he could allow his eastern expedition.
people: 決定開戰與停戰的兩個人，一端是安條克三世（大王，前二六一年至前二二三年在位），一端是歐提德莫斯一世。歐提德莫斯本是馬格尼西亞人，在巴克特里亞任將領時擊敗了逐走總督狄奧多圖斯的薩迦游牧部族，自己建立了王位，卻沒有獨力守住這片新土的把握，遂遣使向安條克三世提議瓜分東方帝國；安條克三世視之為受辱，斷然拒絕，轉而以宗主之師自居，發兵東征。歐提德莫斯的處境由此變得微妙：他既要對付游牧部族的反覆侵擾，又要在塞琉古的兵鋒前保住剛剛取得的王位。他最痛心的選擇，是把長子德米特里奧斯送到塞琉古軍中作人質；傳記記載這位王子後來死在羅馬，若屬實，則勝方的宮廷裡失去了王子。狄奧多圖斯一世的名字提醒人們，此地原本是亞歷山大繼承者時代的塞琉古邊省，總督阿波羅多托斯當年正是因為不肯支付贖金而殺死了被俘的貝索斯，說明巴克特里亞的歸屬問題在安條克三世之前就已被反覆爭奪。戰局之外，米特里達梯一世率領的安息在阿里烏斯河夜戰中重創安條克三世的軍隊，是迫使塞琉古在巴克特里亞收手的外部力量；孔雀王朝的使節約於前二〇八年至前二〇五年間抵達安條克三世的營中，帶來印度象與通向南亞的渠道。波利比奧斯的《歷史》第十一卷是本役最詳細的同時代記載，查士丁尼的《腓力史》第四十一卷則是它的拉丁文提要。
peopleEn: Two men decided how this war began and how it ended, one at either end of it: Antiochus III the Great, who reigned from 261 to 223 BC, and Euthydemus I. Euthydemus was a native of Magnesia who, while serving as a commander in Bactria, defeated the Saka nomads who had expelled the satrap Diodotus, and he founded a kingship of his own, but he had no confidence that he could hold this new land alone; he therefore sent an embassy to Antiochus III proposing that the empire in the east be divided between them. Antiochus took this as an insult, refused it outright, and asserted his position as overlord, then sent an army east. Euthydemus's position was from that moment doubly awkward: he had to meet the recurrent pressure of the nomads while preserving the kingship he had just won against the spear of the Seleucids. His most painful choice was to send his elder son Demetrius to the Seleucid camp as a hostage; the tradition records that the prince died later at Rome, and if that is right, then the winning side lost a prince in its own court. The name of Diodotus I is a reminder that this country had been a Seleucid frontier province in the age of Alexander's successors: the satrap Apollodotus had killed the captive Bessus rather than pay his ransom, which shows that the question of who owned Bactria had been argued over long before Antiochus III. Outside the battlefield, the Parthia of Mithridates I struck Antiochus III's army hard in the night battle at the Araxes, and it was this external force that obliged the Seleucids to stop short in Bactria; the envoys of the Mauryan Empire reached Antiochus's camp between about 208 and 205 BC, bringing Indian elephants and a channel of contact with South Asia. Book XI of Polybius is the fullest contemporary account of the campaign, and Book XLI of Justin's Epitome of the Philippic Histories is its Latin summary.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬早王朝時期的工藝：木杆前端以銅或青銅矛頭綁合，形制簡潔，用途是守城垣與近身刺擊。它早於本役約三千年，因此在巴克特里亞的戰場上不可能出現；它真正的位置是一條形制血脈的源頭——長杆刺擊這一路，最終在希臘化世界變成了方陣步兵的薩里沙。塞琉古軍中真正決定正面交戰結果的是方陣：以約五至六公尺長的薩里沙結成的密集長矛林，配合青銅或鐵製胸甲、頭盔與圓盾，抵禦騎兵衝撞；其前有標槍手與輕裝步兵清場，兩翼為弓手與投石手投射，騎兵護衛方陣側翼。攻城時換成另一套裝備：撞槌、覆以牛皮的攻城塔、填壕用的柴束與土石、配合標槍手與工匠組成的作業隊，以及用來撞開城門與塔樓的印度象，象背披鎧甲，象夫執長矛。防守一方與薩迦聯軍的冷兵器則輕便得多：短複合反曲弓配箭袋、彎刀、標槍與鑲皮鱗甲，騎兵配短弓與套索；希臘巴克特里亞軍仍保有馬其頓式的方陣與胸甲騎兵，但作戰重心放在城牆與城郊游擊。裝備的來源與流向同樣重要：巴克特里亞位於興都庫什北麓的綠洲平原，農作與畜群是養活圍城大軍的基礎；安息控制著花剌子模與粟特的商路，沿線駱駝商隊把糧秣輸進塞琉古的營地，也把消息帶向地中海世界。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the craftwork of the early dynastic period: a wooden shaft with a copper or bronze head bound to its front, plain in form, built for holding walls and for stabbing at close quarters. It stands roughly three thousand years before the campaign in question and so cannot have been present on the field in Bactria; its true position is that of a source in a lineage of form, since the long thrusting spear was in the end transformed, in the Hellenistic world, into the sarissa of the phalanx. What really decided the outcome of the frontal fighting in the Seleucid army was the phalanx: a dense forest of sarissas about five to six metres long, backed by bronze or iron cuirasses, helmets and round shields, able to absorb the charge of cavalry; javelin-men and light infantry cleared the ground in front of it, archers and slingers on the wings threw their missiles, and cavalry guarded the flanks of the phalanx. For the siege a different set of equipment took over: battering rams, siege towers covered with ox-hide, brushwood and rubble for filling the ditch, work parties of javelin-men and craftsmen, and Indian elephants used to smash gates and corner towers, armoured on the back and driven by elephant-men carrying long spears. The cold weapons of the defenders and of the Saka allies were far lighter: short composite recurved bows with quivers, sabres, javelins and scale armour of leather, and cavalry with short bows and lassoes; the Greco-Bactrian army still kept the Macedonian-style phalanx and cuirassed cavalry, but the weight of its fighting was given to the walls and to harassment outside the city. The source and the flow of equipment mattered as much: Bactria lay in the oasis plain at the northern foot of the Hindu Kush, and its crops and herds were the base on which a besieging army lived; the Parthians held the caravan roads of Khwarezm and Sogdia, and the camel trains along them carried grain into the Seleucid camp and carried news back towards the Mediterranean world.
tactics: 塞琉古軍越興都庫什時採分縱隊行軍：先鋒由騎兵與斥候前出搜索山口，主力步兵縱隊夾在象隊之間，殿後由騎兵與運載隊壓住，隊形在狹窄山口被迫拉成單列，一出山口再展開。阿里烏斯河畔的騎兵戰是全役的轉折：巴克特里亞與薩迦聯軍把騎兵壓在前，巴克特里亞的方陣步兵居中，薩迦騎兵列於左翼；安條克三世以右翼騎兵迂迴包抄，配合正面重騎的反覆衝鋒，使聯軍左翼先行潰散，中軍被衝垮，退路被截斷，營地隨即被攻破，遊牧騎兵大潰。接著便是圍攻巴克特拉的堡壘：塞琉古以弓手與投石手覆蓋城頭，以撞槌與工匠作業隊攻擊外牆，以象撞擊城門與角樓，並用柴石填塞壕溝；圍城持續約兩年，其間安條克三世必須同時應付西線安息的威脅，這正是他無法把巴克特里亞徹底消滅的原因。歐提德莫斯的守方戰術以拖為主：利用城牆與綠洲平原的糧源，依托巴克特里亞諸城的網絡與薩迦騎兵的外線游擊遲滯塞琉古的補給，最後以議和收場——交出人質、支付貢賦、保留王位，換取塞琉古撤軍西去。停戰之後安條克三世回師再東返時，又對歐提德莫斯加壓，後者被迫再送子為質並交付更多貢賦。
tacticsEn: The Seleucid army crossed the Hindu Kush in columns: a vanguard of cavalry and outriders searching ahead for the passes, the main body of infantry marching between the elephants, and cavalry with the baggage train covering the rear, so that in the narrow defiles the formation was drawn out into single file and only opened out again once clear of the mountains. The cavalry battle on the Arius was the turning point of the whole campaign. The Bactrian and Saka allies put their cavalry in front, the Bactrian phalanx in the centre and the Saka horsemen on the left wing; Antiochus III sent his right wing round to envelop them while his heavy cavalry charged again and again in front, so that the allied left wing broke first, the centre was carried, the retreat was cut off, and the camp was stormed, the nomad cavalry scattering in confusion. Then came the siege of the fortress of Bactra: the Seleucids covered the walls with archers and slingers, worked at the outer defences with rams and parties of craftsmen, drove their elephants against gates and corner towers, and filled the ditches with brushwood and rubble; the siege lasted about two years, and throughout it Antiochus III had to meet the threat from the Parthians in the west, which is precisely why he could not liquidate Bactria entirely. Euthydemus's method on the defensive was to gain time: he leaned on the walls and on the grain of the oasis plain, on the network of Bactrian cities and on Saka cavalry operating outside the walls to slow the Seleucid supply lines, and he ended the war by negotiation, giving hostages, paying tribute and keeping his kingship in exchange for the Seleucid army withdrawing westward. When Antiochus III came back east after that truce he put fresh pressure on Euthydemus, who was forced to send another son as hostage and to hand over more tribute.
data: 可依史料核對的數字大致如下。年代：本次入侵在卡面繫於公元前二一〇年，波利比奧斯的敘事則把安條克三世越過興都庫什山與阿里烏斯河之戰記在公元前二〇八年，圍城自前二〇八年延續到前二〇六年，兩個時點相差不過兩年，並不衝突。圍城歷時：波利比奧斯記巴克特里亞堡壘被圍攻甚久，查士丁尼則概括為約兩年。地理：巴克特拉即今阿富汗巴爾赫，北緯三十六點七度、東經六十六點九度，位於興都庫什山北麓的巴克特里亞綠洲；阿里烏斯河一般認為即今赫拉特附近的阿里河，也有學者指為阿拉克斯河，安條克三世的進軍方向是由帕提亞與米底東側的通道折向東南，實際路線因此繞行數百公里。距離與地形：興都庫什的山口海拔逾四千米，谷底與山口之間落差極大，冬季積雪使大象與輜重車隊難以通行，這是塞琉古軍隊在春季出發、並在越嶺後即尋求決戰的直接原因。武器規格：方陣長矛薩里沙全長約五至六公尺。外交數字：孔雀王朝約於前二〇八年至前二〇五年遣使至安條克三世營中，見於阿育王詔令提到雅瓦那國王的敕文，此行帶來印度象；羅馬於前二〇五年派遣五名使節前往亞細亞。兵員：本役的具體兵力在傳世文獻中沒有留下數目，波利比奧斯只記述了戰役的過程與地點，唯一的量度是圍城的時間與地理距離。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked against the sources are roughly these. Date: on the card the invasion is entered at 210 BC, while Polybius places Antiochus III's crossing of the Hindu Kush and the battle on the Arius in 208 BC, and the siege running from 208 to 206 BC, so the two datings differ by no more than two years and do not conflict. Duration of the siege: Polybius says the fortress of the Bactrians was besieged for a long time, and Justin summarises it as about two years. Geography: Bactra, modern Balkh in Afghanistan, lies at 36.7 degrees north and 66.9 degrees east, in the oasis of Bactria at the northern foot of the Hindu Kush; the Arius is generally identified with the Ari or Hari river near Herat, though some scholars take it for the Araxes, and Antiochus III's line of march came by way of the corridor on the Parthian and Median side, turning south-east, so that the actual route ran for several hundred kilometres. Distance and terrain: the passes of the Hindu Kush stand above four thousand metres, the drop between valley floor and pass is extreme, and winter snow makes it hard for elephants and baggage wagons to move, which is the direct reason why the Seleucid army set out in spring and sought a decision as soon as it was over the mountains. Weapon specification: the phalanx sarissa is about five to six metres in overall length. Diplomatic figures: the Mauryan Empire sent an embassy to Antiochus III between about 208 and 205 BC, as the edicts of Ashoka mentioning the Yavana king show, and that embassy brought Indian elephants; Rome sent five envoys to Asia in 205 BC. Numbers of troops: no figures for the strength of the force survive in the transmitted literature; Polybius describes the course of the campaign and the places, and the only measurements are the length of the siege and the distances of the ground.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因是一件外交上的失禮。安條克三世的表兄、巴克特里亞總督狄奧多圖斯宣布獨立，又與安條克二世交戰而未敗，此後維持獨立；在安條克二世死後，邊境各省陸續脫離，塞琉古的東方疆界崩解成一連串的獨立王國，而塞琉古帝國本身的統一也一直拖到安條克三世手上才真正完成。就在這個節骨眼上，巴克特里亞的遊牧部族薩迦人南侵，殺死了狄奧多圖斯並把希臘移民趕出城邑；歐提德莫斯靠本地徵召的兵力和幾場城市保衛戰才把薩迦人擋在巴克特里亞平原之外，穩住了局面，卻明白單靠希臘式方陣無法長期抵禦以騎兵為主的游牧部落。他於是派使團到安條克三世那裡提議瓜分東方帝國、共治亞洲，這在安條克三世看來，是把宗主對屬下的保護說成了分贓。安條克三世拒絕，並很快作出用兵的決定。除此之外還有三重考慮：塞琉古需要在安息崛起、巴克特里亞獨立、興都庫什與印度通道橫在東方的局面裡畫出一條可守的邊界；安條克三世即位後先要平定兄長安條克·海拉克斯的叛亂，急需一場對外勝利來鞏固權位；東征之際他不能忽略安息，米特里達梯一世的帕提亞正從裏海東南向美索不達米亞與呼羅珊擴張，任何在東方的長期羈縶都會把後方交給敵人。
causeEn: The immediate cause of this war was a diplomatic piece of tactlessness. Diodotus, satrap of Bactria and a kinsman of the Seleucid house, had declared independence and had fought Antiochus II without being defeated, and had kept it; after the death of Antiochus II the frontier provinces broke away one after another, the eastern limits of the Seleucid state dissolved into a string of independent kingdoms, and the reunification of the empire itself was only carried through under Antiochus III. Exactly at that moment the Saka nomads of Bactria raided southward, killed Diodotus and drove the Greek colonists out of the cities; Euthydemus, with troops raised locally and by a few successful defence of the towns, managed to hold the Saka off in the plain of Bactria and to steady the situation, but he understood well that a Greek-style phalanx could not in the long run hold off nomads whose strength was mounted. He therefore sent an embassy to Antiochus III proposing that the empire in the east be divided and Asia ruled jointly, which in the ears of Antiochus III was nothing other than the overlord's protection being turned into a share of the spoils. Antiochus refused, and soon made up his mind to use force. Three further calculations lay behind it. The Seleucid state had to draw a defensible line through a landscape in which Parthian power was rising, Bactria was independent, and the Hindu Kush with the road to India lay across its eastern horizon. Antiochus III, having first had to deal with the revolt of his brother Antiochus Hierax, needed a victory abroad to steady his own position. And he could not ignore Parthia while campaigning in the east, for Mithridates I was extending the Arsacid power from the south-east of the Caspian towards Mesopotamia and Khurasan, and any long entanglement in the east would have handed the rear of his army to the enemy.
impact: 巴克特里亞此後半個多世紀不再是獨立的希臘王國。安條克三世以巴克特拉為塞琉古東方行省的中心，駐有軍官與守軍，歐提德莫斯以附庸之王的名義統治本國，家族與城市網絡得以保存，卻不再有對外獨立的權力；這段附庸期延續到德米特里奧斯一世於前二〇二年前後藉塞琉古在安條克戰爭後的虛弱重新宣稱獨立，建立德米特里歐斯王朝，直到前二世紀中葉才被自西北遷來的貴霜人所取代。邊界線也因而被畫定：興都庫什山成為塞琉古世界的東端門戶，通往印度的商路與佛教僧侶、商人先後沿著同一條走廊西行，安條克三世營中出現的印度象即是這條通道上最醒目的物證。對薩迦人而言，慘敗意味著向南方與西南方的另一條道路被打開，其後數個世紀他們沿索格底亞與巴克特里亞的河谷地帶南下，成為帕提亞邊境長期不能根除的騷擾源，進而與西遷的匈奴、月氏等流動匯合，成為絲路中段政治變動的一部分。往更遠處看，安條克三世把大量兵力和財政耗在東方的兩年圍城上，削弱了他在西線對安息的攻勢；前二〇六年阿里烏斯河夜戰的慘敗更迫使他提前結束東征，也使他前二一二年起對安息的戰役以失敗告終，國家元氣大傷，這些都為前一九二年塞琉古與羅馬開戰時的實力不足埋下伏線。
impactEn: For more than half a century after this, Bactria was no longer an independent Greek kingdom. Antiochus III made Bactra the centre of the Seleucid eastern province and stationed officers and garrison there; Euthydemus ruled his own country in the title of a client king, so that his dynasty and the network of his cities survived, but he no longer possessed an independent foreign policy. The period of clienthood ran until Demetrius I, around 202 BC, took advantage of the weakness of the Seleucids after the war against Antiochus to proclaim independence again and found the Demetrid dynasty, which lasted until the middle of the second century BC, when the Kushans arriving from the north-west replaced it. The frontier line was drawn as well: the Hindu Kush became the eastern gateway of the Seleucid world, and the road to India, along with Buddhist monks and merchants, ran westward over the same corridor; the Indian elephants in Antiochus III's camp are the most conspicuous evidence of that channel. For the Saka, the defeat opened another road southward and to the south-west, and for centuries they came down along the valleys of Sogdia and Bactria, becoming a source of harassment on the Parthian frontier that was never rooted out, and later merging with the movements of the Huns and Yuezhi to the west, one of the elements in the political changes of the middle Silk Road. Looking further ahead, Antiochus III spent men and money on two years of siege in the east, which weakened his offensive against the Parthians in the west; the heavy defeat in the night battle at the Araxes in 206 BC forced him to end his eastern campaign early and brought the war he had waged against Parthia since 212 BC to an unsuccessful end, leaving the state exhausted. All of this laid the groundwork for the Seleucid shortfall of strength that showed itself when war with Rome began in 192 BC.
result: 就戰役本身而言，結果是塞琉古的勝利：安條克三世取得阿里烏斯河畔的騎兵戰，攻破營地，包圍巴克特拉堡壘約兩年，最後迫得歐提德莫斯接受和約——交出人質、支付貢賦、承認塞琉古宗主權，長子德米特里奧斯留作人質，歐提德莫斯的王位得以保留，希臘巴克特里亞則從獨立的希臘王國降為塞琉古體系中的一個附庸王國。塞琉古並未把巴克特里亞直接併為行省，這一點在史料與現代研究中仍有爭議，較穩妥的說法是附庸加駐軍的雙重安排。勝利的代價同樣清楚：為圍城耗去的兩年，正是安息在西方施壓的兩年，前二〇六年阿里烏斯河畔的夜戰中安條克三世的大軍被帕提亞人擊潰，使他無法再把戰事延長；而人質制度在這場勝利裡留下的裂痕最深，歐提德莫斯送出的王子後來死在羅馬，這段悲劇使希臘化世界的君主外交第一次為代價付出與戰功不相稱的東西。長期看，塞琉古在巴克特里亞建立的秩序只維持了半個多世紀，德米特里奧斯一世重新獨立、另立王朝，說明一次成功的遠征解決的是邊界的承認，解決不了地方政權的存續問題。
resultEn: As a campaign, the result was a Seleucid victory: Antiochus III won the cavalry battle on the Arius, stormed the camp, and after a siege of about two years before the fortress of Bactra forced Euthydemus to accept terms, handing over hostages, paying tribute and acknowledging Seleucid overlordship, with his elder son Demetrius left as a hostage, so that Euthydemus kept his kingship and the Greco-Bactrian kingdom was reduced from an independent Greek state to a client kingdom within the Seleucid system. The Seleucids did not annex Bactria directly as a province, a point on which the sources and modern scholarship still differ; the safer reading is the double arrangement of client status and garrison. The price of the victory was equally plain: the two years spent in the siege were the two years in which Parthia pressed from the west, and in the night battle at the Araxes in 206 BC Antiochus III's army was broken by the Parthians, which prevented him from carrying the war further. The deepest crack left by this victory was in the institution of hostages, for the prince Euthydemus sent away died later at Rome, and that tragedy made the diplomacy of the Hellenistic monarchs pay for the first time a price out of all proportion to the glory won. In the long run the order the Seleucids established in Bactria lasted no more than half a century, and Demetrius I reasserted independence and founded a new dynasty, which shows that a successful expedition settles the recognition of a frontier but not the survival of the local power.
